title: USPS semi-truck ends up partially over I-35W railing in Fort Worth due to wet weather
summary: Wet weather triggered a string of crashes across Fort Worth on Sunday, including a USPS truck that ended up partially over a railing and an 18-wheeler crash on northbound I-35W near 28th Street. Police said no fatalities or major injuries were reported in any of the crashes.

title: 2 minors killed, 3 others seriously injured after van crashes and catches fire in Fort Worth
summary: A Toyota Sienna overturned and caught fire near a creek in north Fort Worth, not far from the Stockyards. The driver and another passenger, both minors, died at the scene; two juveniles and an 18-year-old were taken to the hospital with serious injuries. A Texas DPS trooper had tried to stop the speeding van about half a mile away but lost sight of it before finding the crash. DPS is investigating.

title: UT Southwestern a step closer to opening of Radiation Oncology center
summary: UT Southwestern placed the final beam on its $177 million radiation oncology center in the Fort Worth Medical District on Nov. 16, moving a step closer to the anticipated 2028 opening. The center will offer MRI-guided radiation treatments, a first for Fort Worth.

title: Where to eat in Fort Worth: 5 tasty new restaurants to try
summary: New this month: Beverly's Downtown, an underground Mexican restaurant in the basement of the historic Hogan Building at 901 Houston St. (opened Nov. 10); Flora House Cafe at the Fort Worth Botanic Garden (ribbon cutting Nov. 11); Yindee Thai Eatery, opening Nov. 19 at H Mart Plaza on NE Loop 820; and Station & Vine, set to open inside the historic Texas & Pacific Station across from Dickies Arena.

title: A first look at Beverly's Downtown, Fort Worth's new underground Mexican restaurant
summary: Beverly's Downtown opened Nov. 10 in the basement of the historic Hogan Building at 901 Houston St., bringing a subterranean Mexican restaurant to downtown Fort Worth.

title: Horned Frogs get back on winning track with 20-10 win over Kansas State
summary: Jaden Craig threw for 225 yards and a touchdown to Jacobe Hayes while TCU's defense piled up five sacks and two takeaways in a 20-10 win over Kansas State in Fort Worth on Saturday. TCU improved to 5-5 (3-4 Big 12); Kansas State fell to 4-6. The Frogs host No. 2 Utah next.

title: Clear skies, chilly temps and the Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight over North Texas
summary: Clear skies and chilly temperatures are in the forecast as the Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight. A cold front arrives Saturday night with a low chance of rain and seasonal temperatures returning by Sunday.

title: Fort Worth forecast for Tuesday, November 17
summary: Today: Sunny, high near 65. Wednesday: Sunny, high near 70. Showers possible before noon Thursday, then highs in the low-to-mid 70s into Saturday. A weak cold front arrives Saturday night with a 20 to 40 percent chance of rain this weekend.

title: Ty Myers: The Legal Tour 2026 at Dickies Arena
summary: Ty Myers brings The Legal Tour 2026 with special guest Benny G to Dickies Arena on Saturday, Nov. 21 at 7:30 PM. Country.

title: Women's Funkytown Showdown at Dickies Arena
summary: Elite women's college basketball comes to Dickies Arena on Sunday, Nov. 22 starting at noon: TCU vs. Utah State and Texas vs. Ohio State.
